caption: The drawing depicts a single, chalice-shaped goblet with a wide opening, narrow stem, and a wide circular base, rendered in shades of gray pencil on a light beige background. The goblet is metallic in appearance, indicated by the reflective shading. Inscribed on the front of the cup are the words "Christ Church," followed by “George Town,” and “D.C." in a stylized script within an outlined cartouche. In the lower left corner of the drawing is a rectangular swatch displaying horizontal lines and the letters “C.A.B.” within a shaded box. The composition is simple, with the goblet centered and occupying most of the vertical space on the page, and the swatch situated separately in the bottom left, against otherwise empty background.
title: Silver Communion Cup
